details: Rules differ by university and subject; commonly Indian 12th leads to Studienkolleg, or 12th plus 1 year university in India, or entrance exams such as JEE Advanced for some universities. Verify on anabin, DAAD and uni-assist.
One-year preparatory course ending with Feststellungsprufung; usually needs German skills (often B1 to enter, higher later).
German-taught Bachelors are common; English Bachelors are fewer and often at private universities.
Public universities have low semester fees; private universities charge tuition; blocked account still required.
Start 12-18 months early because of Studienkolleg and language learning.
